metric_definitions.total_vehicle_hours_delay: Sum over in-scope vehicles of SUMO timeLoss (time lost against each vehicle's own free speed) plus departDelay (time waiting to enter), up to the end of the run.
metric_definitions.delay_vs_do_nothing_pct: Change in total_vehicle_hours_delay against the P0 run of the same scenario; zero for P0.
metric_definitions.max_queue_m: Per named path: largest distance over the run from the downstream end of the path's first edge back to the last waiting vehicle, following SUMO's queue output upstream edge by edge for as long as each edge's queue reaches its upstream end. Sampled every 10 seconds. It cannot exceed the path's length: near 100% in queue_share_of_path_pct means the queue ran off the path.
metric_definitions.corridor_tt_p95_min: 95th percentile (nearest rank) of time in the network for in-scope vehicles on the scenario's corridor route. A vehicle still driving at the end counts with its time so far.
metric_definitions.emergency_tt_min: Length of each emergency-route edge divided by the mean speed of all traffic on it from closure onset to the end of the run, summed. An edge no vehicle used counts at its speed limit. General traffic, not blue-light running.
metric_definitions.co2_kg: Sum of SUMO's CO2 for in-scope vehicles, default emission class for every vehicle. Vehicles waiting outside the network emit nothing.
metric_definitions.residential_delay_share_pct: Share of all edge timeLoss after the warm-up that falls on edges of the scenario's residential types. Excludes time waiting to enter.
metric_definitions.vehicles_completed: In-scope vehicles that finished their trip before the run ended.
metric_definitions.validation: src/twin/evaluate.py, unchanged, over every observed bin after the warm-up (P0 only), rounded to two decimals towards failing.
